power_intent.phantom_power: DC bus power delivered to downstream nodes over the same twisted pair that carries the audio/control signal.
power_intent.switching: switched segment-by-segment during discovery; a node powers its downstream segment only when instructed, which gates the discovery order.
node_power_options: local-powered (own supply where the bus cannot deliver enough power)
power_intent.fault_detection: per-segment over-current / under-voltage detection, reported upstream.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
